description: This PHP class, DataGroupHelper, manages permissions related to data groups, API endpoints, and screens in an enterprise HR management system. It includes methods for reading permissions from YAML files, inserting permissions into a database, and retrieving identifiers for modules, data groups, screens, and user roles.

classes.name: DataGroupHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing data group, API, and screen permissions within the HRM system, including database interactions and YAML parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: readApiPermissions
methods.description: Reads API permission data from a YAML file and creates Api DTO objects.

methods.name: readDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Reads data group permission data from a YAML file and creates DataGroup DTO objects.

methods.name: readScreenPermissions
methods.description: Reads screen permission data from a YAML file and creates Screen DTO objects.

methods.name: insertApiPermissions
methods.description: Inserts API permissions and their associations into the database from a YAML file.

methods.name: insertDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Inserts data group permissions into the database from a YAML file.

methods.name: insertScreenPermissions
methods.description: Inserts screen permissions into the database from a YAML file, including roles.

methods.name: getDataGroupIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a data group given its name.

methods.name: getScreenIdByModuleAndUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a screen based on module ID and URL.

methods.name: getModuleIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a module given its name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: getUserRoleIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a user role given its name, with caching.

methods.name: addDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions for a user role on a specified data group.
